title: Selling Plans Seller Tenure Bonus on Discount Dispute Credits
content:
A discount dispute credit on **Selling Plans** carries a tenure bonus that grows with the time since the seller's selling plan was verified. The tenure is read from the plan record's verification date.

**Clause.** The tenure bonus of a discount dispute credit is the long-tenure bonus when the selling plan was verified at least the long tenure months before the decision date, the mid-tenure bonus when it was verified at least the mid tenure months but fewer than the long tenure months before, and nothing otherwise, the tenure being counted in whole months.

The tenure bonus is added to the discount dispute rate of the credit. Bonuses are added together with that rate first and the total is applied once to the variable final value fee billed on the disputed record; no bonus acts on another.

| Whole months from the plan's verification date to the decision date | Tenure bonus |
|---|---|
| 36 or more (the long tenure months) | Long-tenure bonus: 2 percentage points |
| 24 or more but fewer than 36 (the mid tenure months up to the long) | Mid-tenure bonus: 1 percentage point |
| Fewer than 24 | None |

## Counting whole months (hypothetical dates)

A plan verified on 15 March 2023:

- decided on 15 March 2026 → 36 whole months → 2 points;
- decided on 14 March 2026 → 35 whole months → 1 point;
- decided on 15 March 2025 → 24 whole months → 1 point;
- decided on 14 March 2025 → 23 whole months → no tenure bonus.
